svg.aria-label: Day 4: on a spotlit stage a student presents a slide called Exploring our digital carbon footprint, where phones and laptops lead to a data centre and CO2. A floating card marks his chunks and stress: ToDAY / I’d like to TALK about //. Classmates in front cheer and hold up a tick card, a question bubble and a heart, and on the right six numbered stepping stones climb to a flag.
